packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates. The full CI build + the required Chromatic 'UI Tests' status check are the gate: patch/minor bumps land unattended only when the app still builds, behaves, and looks pixel-identical. See ADR-0017.

Major updates always land by hand. A green gate proves 'still works and looks the same', which a major (React 19->20, Tailwind 4->5, a Radix major) can pass while changing API/behaviour semantics no pixel diff reveals.
